However, the results and prompts expressions exempt every descendant under two directories, not only verified frozen records. The supplied evidence does not establish their contents or prevent future runtime or product copy from being placed there and bypassing the guard. The declared boundary therefore needs an inventory or enforceable restriction before it can be accepted.

Execution and bundle regeneration remain separately unverified.
